--test-threads=1 cited per memory feedback_env_var_test_flakiness for tests that touch transport env vars

Discovery-Required section enumerates the three pieces of the existing recovery flow that are not directly testable as drafted (share-bytes custody is metadata-only on DHT; no existing libp2p two-stack baseline; no per-share transport observability) — each with a concrete mitigation, none of which redesigns the protocol
